rule: Select one primary packet. Actual proof dependencies and status require original evidence; upstream lists are advisory. Review nominees recuse if contributors.

assignments.target_statement: Audit the prime-gate and shared-data closure results with all biases and overlaps explicit. Recompute constants independently and inspect the terminal cases.

deliverables.description: COMPOSITION_REVIEW.md: independent coefficient, bias, and constant reconstruction
COMPOSITION_SCOPE.json: exact admitted gates, inputs, and closure operations

acceptance_criteria: Check fresh selectors, neighboring correlation/disagreement, repeated variables, and genuine disjointness at every composition node.
Recompute all constants and deterministic/near-dictator endpoints using the actual product normalization.
Treat max{2/c,C} as baseline, replay bent-splice and all three weighted payment failures, and keep conditional-input TC separate from spectral erasure.
assignments.renewal_milestone: One new composition/prime-gate theorem receives a complete independent verdict at its exact scope.

assignments.target_statement: Verify new Boolean counterexamples from original truth tables or circuit definitions. Confirm the exact target they refute and the rigorous sign of the violation.

deliverables.description: COUNTEREXAMPLE_REVIEW.md: independent Boolean and inequality verification
COUNTEREXAMPLE_SCOPE.json: exact refuted statement, coefficient, and quantifiers

acceptance_criteria: Reconstruct the function from its original truth table/circuit before accepting any supplied spectrum or ratio.
Check the sign with exact or certified arithmetic and verify the asymptotic range if an infinite family is claimed.
Name the precise claim refuted; local charge, fixed coefficient, normalized relaxation, and full FEI are distinct outcomes.
The existing B19 review of the B05 no-go may satisfy the first review instance when its immutable source receipt is adopted. This does not complete all future rolling reviews.
assignments.renewal_milestone: One counterexample becomes a reusable source-pinned control only after its actual scope and rigorous sign are independently verified.

assignments.target_statement: Check primary versions, corrections, and withdrawn claims relevant to each new theorem. Record theorem-level overlap and avoid a latest-best or first-result claim without sufficient evidence.

deliverables.description: PRIMARY_SOURCE_OVERLAP.md: theorem-level comparison and current version/correction pins
CITATION_STATUS.json: exact references, overlap, and unresolved priority claims

acceptance_criteria: Read primary papers/preprints and their current corrections relevant to the exact theorem, rather than relying on title matches or secondary summaries.
Compare assumptions, constants, normalization, and consequences theorem by theorem.
Leave priority/first/latest-best claims unasserted when coverage is insufficient; record actual retrieval dates and versions.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A candidate theorem has a complete citation/overlap check sufficient for its scoped presentation, with any remaining novelty uncertainty explicit.

assignments.target_statement: Challenge the strongest complete-looking argument from A086-A090, independently selecting difficult regimes and embeddings. Agreement counts only after examining the full proof chain.

deliverables.description: SECOND_CHAIN_CHALLENGE.md: independently selected hard regimes and embeddings
SECOND_REVIEW_VERDICT.json: accepted scope, unresolved leaf, or counterexample

acceptance_criteria: Read the complete candidate proof and original dependencies independently; the first referee's verdict is not evidence for a missing step.
Choose difficult limits and arbitrary-seed embeddings independently and test the exact highest-risk implications.
For full FEI, verify the entire chain and all known applicable controls; ensure neither this reviewer nor the first reviewer contributed the theorem being approved.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A second substantive independent complete-chain verdict is available for the strongest reviewable candidate.

assignments.target_statement: When a universal proof fails, isolate a complete nontrivial class theorem, sharp obstruction, or useful equivalence suitable for a separate manuscript with honest scope.

deliverables.description: RESTRICTED_RESULT.tex: complete nontrivial theorem, obstruction, or equivalence

acceptance_criteria: Extract a statement whose entire proof is closed; do not hide the failed universal lemma in a weaker theorem's hypothesis unless that condition is explicit.
Demonstrate a useful nontrivial class, sharp obstruction, or exact equivalence and compare it with existing primary results.
If contributing new mathematics to the extraction, recuse from its approval and request an uninvolved full-source review.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A self-contained publishable-scope partial result with a complete proof and an honest frontier.
